leadText:
Pokémon Advanced is the opening theme song for the dub of the sixth and seventh seasons of as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from EP263 to AG092.

The opening animation for the sixth season featured footage from the fifth and sixth English openings, Believe in Me and I Wanna Be a Hero; the opening animation for the seventh season featured footage from the seventh English opening, This Dream. Both versions also used clips from various episodes of their respective seasons.

==Trivia==
Being featured in 104 episodes, this is the most-used Italian opening theme.
This is the first Italian opening theme to be kept for more than one full season.
Both this opening theme and the following one, , were used for two seasons of each.
